prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one objectively “best” attorney for every car‑accident case. The right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether the case will likely settle or go to trial, and how you want to work with the lawyer.

How to pick the best Chicago lawyer for your claim
- Relevant experience: look for attorneys who handle serious car‑accident/personal‑injury cases (not just minor fender‑benders or insurance defense). Trial experience is important if your case may go to court.  
- Track record: past settlements and jury verdicts in similar cases.  
- Reputation: peer ratings (AVVO, Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers), client reviews, and any disciplinary history with the Illinois Bar.  
- Resources: firm size and ability to investigate (medical experts, accident reconstruction) if your case is complex.  
- Communication and availability: a clear primary contact, prompt responses, and regular updates.  
- Fee structure: most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover); confirm percentages and who pays costs if you lose.  

Chicago firms/attorneys commonly recommended (start your vetting here)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard  
- Power Rogers & Smith  

(These firms have strong reputations in Chicago personal injury practice; you should still verify current reviews/records and speak to an attorney about your specific facts.)

Questions to ask at a free consult
- Have you handled cases like mine? How many? What were the typical results?  
- Do you try cases or mostly settle? What percentage go to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day‑to‑day? Will I meet that person?  
- What is your fee and what costs will be advanced?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- Can you give references from recent clients?

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short phone/email script to contact 3–5 attorneys.  
- Help you prioritize firms based on your ZIP code, injuries, and if there are complicating factors (drunk driver, uninsured motorist, major medical bills).  
Tell me a few details (when/where the crash happened, injuries, whether police/insurer are involved, and your ZIP code) and I’ll help you next steps.
